brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished 12 commercial storage units Tuesday at the main entrance to 'Anza, a village south of Jenin in the northern West Bank, IMEMC News reported. The 'Anza village council said Israeli forces arrived in two armored vehicles and conducted the operation at the village entrance area.

The demolished structures served commercial purposes and housed storage facilities used by local residents and businesses. The operation left the village without access to storage infrastructure at its main entry point. Israeli forces have carried out repeated demolition campaigns across the occupied West Bank, destroying Palestinian-owned structures classified as lacking proper permits under Israeli military administration.
